{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Full beam versus optimized half beam",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Fig. 2B's caption says only half is optimized, but Sec. V-A and Eq. 11 do not identify whether 192×64 describes that half or the full beam.",
      "readings": [
        "192×64 is the optimized half; the mirrored full beam is 384×64.",
        "192×64 is the full beam; optimize a 96×64 half, with 12,288 referring to the stored full field."

      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical coordinates and cell aspect ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. V-A gives pixel counts but no physical coordinate mapping, length units, or explicit statement that cells are square.",
      "readings": [
        "The 192×64 array spans [0,192]×[0,64], with square unit cells.",
        "The array spans [0,3]×[0,1], with square cells.",
        "The array spans [0,1.5]×[0,1], with cells half as wide as they are tall."

      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Lower-corner restraints and half-model boundary conditions",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Fig. 2B's caption calls the lower corners supported without specifying restrained displacement components. Sec. V-A supplies no explicit boundary-condition list.",
      "readings": [
        "Simple vertical supports: in the half model, constrain horizontal displacement on the symmetry edge and vertical displacement at the outer lower corner.",
        "Both lower corners restrain horizontal and vertical displacement; in the half model, also impose the usual horizontal-displacement symmetry condition."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Footprint of each lower-corner support",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The caption identifies the corners but does not distinguish nodal supports from finite supported boundary segments.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain only each corner node.",
        "Constrain a one-cell-long bottom-edge segment adjoining each corner.",
        "Constrain a two-cell-long bottom-edge segment adjoining each corner."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Vertical position of the central force",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Fig. 2B's caption says the force is applied 'at the center' without specifying its height. Here L and H denote the full beam's span and height.",
      "readings": [
        "Top midspan: (L/2,H).",
        "Geometric center: (L/2,H/2).",
        "Bottom midspan: (L/2,0)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the central force",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The caption supplies a force direction and central location, but no load footprint or finite-element force distribution.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force on one node.",
        "The same resultant distributed over a centered boundary segment two cells wide.",
        "The same resultant distributed over a centered boundary segment of width L/16."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Force resultant and full-to-half scaling",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the caption nor Eq. 11 specifies force magnitude, units, or whether a stated force would represent the full-beam or half-model load.",
      "readings": [
        "Full-beam resultant 1; apply 0.5 to the half model.",
        "Half-model resultant 1; the corresponding full-beam resultant is 2.",
        "Full-beam resultant 1000; apply 500 to the half model, in consistent force units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Fixed material near loads and supports",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. V-A gives density bounds but no passive-region mask or statement about solid attachment pads.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive cells; every density is designable.",
        "Fix all cells incident on load and support nodes to density 1.",
        "Fix two-cell-deep solid pads around load and support attachments."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional formulation does not specify uniform thickness or a per-unit-depth convention for assembling stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1 in the selected length units.",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 in the same units.",
        "Uniform thickness t=10 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 11 leaves K abstract, while the finite-element implementation is delegated to Ref. [35]; plane stress versus plane strain is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Overall solid elastic stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No solid Young's modulus or modulus units are supplied. At fixed constitutive ratios and relative void stiffness, its common scale only rescales compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Solid Young's modulus E=1 in normalized units.",
        "Solid Young's modulus E=70 GPa.",
        "Solid Young's modulus E=210 GPa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid constitutive tensor apart from its overall scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. V-A supplies no Poisson ratio, explicit isotropy assumption, or material-axis orientation.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic elasticity with Poisson ratio 0.30.",
        "Isotropic elasticity with Poisson ratio 0.25.",
        "Orthotropic plane-stress elasticity with Ex/Ey=2, Gxy/Ey=0.4, nu_xy=0.25, and the x axis along the span."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Density-to-stiffness interpolation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 11 defines physical densities between 0 and 1 but does not specify how they determine K, including any penalization exponent.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear interpolation: E(rho)=E_min+(E_s-E_min)rho.",
        "SIMP interpolation: E(rho)=E_min+(E_s-E_min)rho^3.",
        "SIMP interpolation: E(rho)=E_min+(E_s-E_min)rho^4."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Stiffness assigned to zero-density cells",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The zero density allowed by Eq. 11 is not accompanied by an ersatz stiffness or a rule for singular structures.",
      "readings": [
        "E_min=0, with singular candidate structures rejected.",
        "E_min/E_s=10^-9.",
        "E_min/E_s=10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Discrete cone-filter definition",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. V-A specifies cone radius 2 but not its distance units, sampling convention, or discrete weights.",
      "readings": [
        "Cell-center index-space weights w=max(0,2-sqrt(di^2+dj^2)).",
        "Cell-center physical-space cone with cutoff 2h_x, using actual horizontal and vertical cell spacings.",
        "Cell-area averages of a continuous cone with support radius two pixel widths."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Cone filter at external boundaries and the symmetry cut",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. V-A gives no padding, boundary-extension, or normalization rule, including whether filtering accounts for the mirrored half.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate neighborhoods at every model boundary and renormalize each output by its available weights.",
        "Mirror across the symmetry cut; truncate and renormalize at physical outer boundaries.",
        "Mirror across the symmetry cut; zero-pad outside physical boundaries and retain the full-kernel normalization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Field on which the volume constraint is enforced",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "V-B supplies 0.4. Eq. 11 constrains physical v, whereas Eq. 12 constrains the field before filtering. Volume preservation or subsequent correction is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Enforce mean density 0.4 before filtering, with no correction afterward.",
        "Determine the sigmoid bias using the filtered field so its mean is 0.4.",
        "Use a volume-preserving cone implementation so both fields have mean 0.4."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Analysis mesh relative to the design pixels",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 192×64 design field and 12,288 variables are stated, but Sec. V-A does not explicitly identify the analysis mesh or density-to-element mapping.",
      "readings": [
        "One analysis element per design pixel, with piecewise-constant element density.",
        "A 2×2 analysis-element subdivision of each design pixel, with all four elements inheriting its density."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Displacement element and integration rule",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The finite-element details are deferred to Ref. [35]; element order and quadrature are absent from the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2×2 Gauss integration.",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration.",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with one-point integration and hourglass stabilization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initialization for a direct density-based rerun",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "V-B describes erosion-based warm starts without giving the seed design or erosion rates. V-C's initialization concerns latent CMA-ES, not a standalone pixel-density solve.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density 0.4.",
        "Seed-0 random densities uniformly sampled from [0.35,0.45], then adjusted to mean 0.4.",
        "A previous optimized design eroded by one cell, then adjusted to the target volume."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Direct density optimizer controls and termination",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "V-B and VI-A identify L-BFGS but omit its history, line search, stopping tolerances, and iteration budget. V-C's stated CMA-ES budget does not specify these.",
      "readings": [
        "L-BFGS history 10, strong-Wolfe line search, maximum 500 iterations, relative compliance-change tolerance 10^-6.",
        "L-BFGS history 100, Armijo backtracking, maximum 2000 iterations, relative compliance-change tolerance 10^-8."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Finite-element equilibrium solution accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. 11 states KU=F but provides no numerical solution method, precision, or residual tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Double-precision sparse direct factorization.",
        "Double-precision preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-8.",
        "Double-precision preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 10^-4."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
